newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia UES shares jump over 10 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Russia UES shares jump over 10 pct in early trade.

text.p: Shares in Russian national electric company UES jumped over 10 percent in the first few minutes of trade on Thursday to $0.4600 at 0731 GMT after $0.4450 at 0724 GMT and $0.4050 at the previous close on the Russian Trading System.
Reported turnover for UES had reached more than $4 million in less than a half hour's trade. Healthy turnover for the entire market is considered about $50 million.
The Russian Trading System 22-share index edged up 0.37 percent at the opening to set a new record of 449.61.
Foreign funds poured into the market on Wednesday, partly on new third quarter allocations, and UES jumped from $0.3724 on Tuesday.
UES prefs, with $1.5 million turnover, rose to $0.2804 at 0747 GMT from $0.2425 on Wednesday.
Investors in Russia were likely cheered by the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision on Wednesday not to raise interest rates, which boosted U.S. stocks in the final hour of trade.
